skills.description: Use when a developer asks what a Bittensor subnet does, whether it's up right now, how to call/integrate its API, or what mining/validating one costs and earns — e.g. "which subnet does image generation", "is subnet 7 healthy", "call the Beam API for me", "does mining subnet 3 need a GPU", "what does the median miner on subnet 13 make". Can EXECUTE subnet API calls, not just describe them. Backed by metagraphed (api.metagraph.sh), the live operational + integration registry for ~129 subnets.
skills.name: bittensor
